about: WILD LINK L3 (One World, the Woods zone thread, BUILD_PLAN phase 3, 2026-11-17; was the kit's proof stretch): the Redwood Trail's Snowline north up to the Snowy Pass's Tree Line, west. Its own room (5 plots): it cannot join the Redwood Trail's room (the box would be 13 plots tall) and two zones never join. Ends: the Snowline's north side (seam ow_h_m17_m9, the Redwood Trail's room) and the Tree Line, west's west side (seam ow_v_m16_m14, the Mountains' Ski Lodge room).
